Scenario 3

You need to copy data from the Customer table in SQL to an ADLS location in CSV format. However, this should only happen if the total number of records in the Customer table is greater than 500.

Once the Customer data is successfully copied, you then need to check the total record count of the Product table. If the Product table has more than 200 records, then copy the Product table data to ADLS as well.

Steps

Get the total record count of the Customer table using a Lookup activity.

Use an If Condition activity to check whether the record count is greater than 500.

If the condition is true, copy the Customer table data to ADLS.

After successfully copying the Customer data, get the record count of the Product table.
